main.description: A subscribed hashtag, in the subscriber's own repo. Unsubscribing = record deleted.

tag.description: The hashtag, bare and lowercase — no leading '#', which is punctuation rather than part of the name. Never empty: an empty tag is not a tag, and the rule lives here rather than in a hand-rolled check so one schema stays the only schema.

createdAt.description: Subscribe time. Also the natural ordering — no stored order is kept.
